subject: Urgent - toothache, need appointment today or tomorrow

results.heading: Pain or swelling
results.text: If you have swelling, fever or pain that keeps you awake, say so in your message: we keep same-day slots for urgent cases.

results.heading: Emergencies
results.text: For dental emergencies outside opening hours, call the emergency line listed on your appointment confirmation. Email is not monitored outside opening hours.

results.heading: Booking an appointment
results.text: New and existing patients can book by email or phone. Tell us what the visit is for (check-up, pain, hygiene, whitening) and two or three preferred days; reception confirms a time.

args.subject: Re: Urgent - toothache, appointment today or tomorrow
args.body:
Dear Ayduru,

I'm sorry to hear about your toothache. We keep same-day slots for urgent cases, so here are the earliest openings I can see:

- Today, Monday 19 October: 10:00, 12:00, 12:30, 13:00, 14:00, 14:30, 17:00 or 17:30
- Tomorrow, Tuesday 20 October: 09:30, 10:00, 10:30 or 11:30

Reply with the time that suits you best and reception will confirm it. If your pain becomes severe, or you have swelling or a fever, please call the clinic straight away. Outside opening hours, use the emergency line listed on your appointment confirmation, as email is not monitored then.

Warm regards,
Nova Dental Clinic reception
